name: Provender
description: Bricks of fabricated food and fibre from the Waystation. Cheap, endless, everyone eats.

name: Data Core
description: Sealed crystalline memory. Prized by collectors of knowledge; the Waystation takes them as currency.

name: Ice Crate
description: Volatiles cut from a claimed ice world: water, ammonia, air.

name: Biomass Crate
description: Living culture and seed stock from a claimed world.

name: Ore Crate
description: Refined metal from a claimed world's surface plant.

name: Isotope Crate
description: Shielded canisters of fissile isotopes. Handle with respect.

name: Survey Log
description: WAKE's account of a newly probed system: its light, its worlds, its silence. Some listeners prize such stories.
